newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters says some informal talks today.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters says some informal talks today.

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters said his party would hold informal contacts with both National and Labour on Monday as it prepares to make its choice of coalition partner.
"Just a few informal meetings to wrap up things with both sides," Peters told reporters. He said New Zealand First was still on track to announce its decision on Tuesday.
Labour was due to meet the Alliance at 11.30 a.m. and National was holding a caucus at 2 p.m.
